The artist sent the final accessibility specification directly to me yesterday, and I have not yet attached it to the lock memo, but I'm doing so now as part of my report. To summarize the revised accessibility requirements: a 12-minute seated orientation per session, and four captioned control tablets reserved for visitors who need them. These replace the draft assumptions of no reserved control tablets and no structured session orientation.
